name: Family & Infant Care
description: A newborn's arrival weaves every conversation into a tapestry of tender vigilance, where feeding schedules and tiny fingernails become the measure of love.

name: Romantic Partnership
description: Two lives move in quiet orbit around each other, navigating roads and evenings with the effortless grammar of long companionship.

name: Tech Product Design
description: Ideas collide in fluorescent meeting rooms where every swipe, sound wave, and event card is a small argument about what technology should feel like.

name: Extended Family & Kinship
description: Grandmothers recall the weight of sleepless nights, aunts remember childhood compliments, and reunion tables hold more stories than food.

name: Friendship & Social Life
description: Friends chase sunsets on bikes, argue over where to eat, and turn ordinary street corners into the backdrop of small, irreplaceable moments.

name: Leisure & Urban Wandering
description: A reluctance to walk uphill and a craving for noodle soup trace the contours of a life that finds meaning in unhurried, aimless afternoons.

name: Travel & Mobility
description: GPS voices guide the car through interchanges while the passenger drifts, half-asleep, trusting the road to carry them somewhere worth arriving.

name: Health & Wellness
description: Herbal pills debated over kitchen tables and vaccine conversations overheard from spouses quietly reveal an ongoing negotiation with the body's uncertainties.
